clause_path: Section 23.2 -- verifier report per-entry shape {pointer, type, structural, verifiable}

obligations.label: attestation outcomes are published next to the hash verdict, in their own right, rather than merged into it

for each input_attestations entry the verifier emits the report fields pointer, type, structural and verifiable; structural covers pointer resolution, digest binding and payload well-formedness; verifiable is the cryptographic verdict, external for zktls and n/a only when a type carries no independent cryptographic check
hash outcomes do not read attestation outcomes at all: nothing an attestation says, good or bad, moves the hash result either way

the section 23 claims attest input provenance only: they do not make an un-attested input trusted and do not prove computational correctness, authorship, kernel identity or existence-in-time; those claims are independent and composable
a user interface presenting attestations must keep the zero-attestation caveat visible
